notes.title: In-Home Streaming Third Update
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome, from the In-Home Streaming Team.

Every week, or at most every two weeks there will be an update to this game on this day of the week.

Today's update includes the use of the taskbar, and the disappearance of the black terminal windows. Once you have started the app, go down to the taskbar and right click the logo, allowing you start the app or the website, or quit out of both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37898107/a33f564e1aaccb104e06b93bc910acc5a70a98b1.png[/img]


Future updates will either be from what the Team would like to add in or from your suggested comments in the reviews or by email at inhomestreamingteam@gmail.com

If you have any bugs or errors happening with the application feel free to contact inhomestreamingteam@gmail.com so we solve the problem that is occuring.

Updates are going to be ordered on first given and by most popular, so if you want you features in quickly just send a message


From the In-Home Streaming Team

notes.title: First Update of In-Home Streaming
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome, from the In-Home Streaming Team.

Every week, or at most every two weeks there will be an update to this game on this day of the week.

This update is for bug fixes for the future allowing updates to work without deleting the saved information.

For this update between the first release and this one, re-entering the information from before will allow you to gain access to the information and it will work the same as before. This is only for the users that have used the first edition to now.

For the next update as suggested in a review planning on having there be a password for gaining access to where you watch the videos.

Future updates will either be from what the Team would like to add in or from your suggested comments in the reviews or by email at inhomestreamingteam@gmail.com

[i]Updates are going to be ordered on first given and by most popular, so if you want you features in quickly just send a message[/i]


From the In-Home Streaming Team
